turns.text: Graphic design. Graphic design combines graphical elements and design principles to communicate a message to an audience.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Line. A line is a visible path. It can divide, connect, outline, or guide.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Color. Color is a visual quality we can change to identify, group, emphasise, or suggest a mood.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Shape. A shape is a two-dimensional area with a boundary.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Texture. Texture is the appearance or feel of a surface. A flat image can suggest a texture.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Space. Space includes the areas occupied by elements and the empty areas within, around, or between them.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Form. Form concerns three-dimensional volume. A flat image can suggest form through light, shadow, and perspective.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Typography. Typography is the visual presentation of written language: letterforms, size, weight, spacing, and arrangement.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Contrast. Contrast is a visible difference between elements, such as light and dark, big and small, or straight and curved.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Hierarchy. Hierarchy establishes an order of importance so viewers know what to notice first and next.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Alignment. Alignment places elements along shared edges, centres, or guides.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Balance. Balance distributes visual weight. It can be symmetrical or asymmetrical.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Proximity. Proximity places related elements close together so their relationship is clearer.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Repetition. Repetition reuses selected visual features to create consistency.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Simplicity. Simplicity removes unnecessary complication while keeping what the message needs.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.

turns.text: Function. Function asks whether the design helps its intended audience understand or do what the brief requires.

provenance: Original lesson definition, synthesised using an installed Apple English voice.
